compareDisposition.rationale: The curator examined A son leaves home and returns beside The child goes into Egypt and returns; Jesus is tested in the wilderness; Jerusalem is addressed as an unwilling gathering; Jesus promises Paradise from the cross. Those passages share its Eden-and-exile evidence group or canonical movement, but none supplies a distinct two-source relationship stronger than the accepted comparisons already carrying this topic.
